cds.source: DTCC SEC public dissemination, end-of-day cumulative credit files
cds.method: Senior single-name trades bucketed by tenor (5Y = on-the-run contract). Quoted points = cash upfront / notional + accrued. Trades above the $5m disclosure cap get a notional only when exactly one $5m–$100m ($1m step) candidate puts the points on the 1/8 grid within ±5 points of the tenor's last level. ISDA standard model, flat hazard, 40% recovery, Treasury par curve of the trade date. Daily median; days without a priced trade carry the previous value.

inversion.rule: Any of 1Y–3Y above 5Y: medians of observed (not carried) values over the last 5 business days, short tenor observed on at least 2 of those days
